name: Interpolation Degree of the Three-Code Class
proof: In coordinate order $(x_0,x_1,x_2)$ the codewords are $000,110,101$.  The evaluation vectors of $1,x_1,x_2$ on these three points are $(1,1,1),(0,1,0),(0,0,1)$, which are linearly independent.  Thus degree-one polynomials interpolate every real-valued function on the class.  Degree zero only gives constants, so the interpolation degree is one.
